I used this approach to lead a taskforce charged with the creation of a playbook for customer onboarding. We deployed ahead of schedule, with an increase in new customer, internal and external stakeholder satisfaction, and a positive shift in service delivery!
One of my proudest achievements has been the opportunity to mentor both individual contributors and leaders; I gained priceless knowledge from the variety of mentees I have supported. Whether a mentee is early in their career or a seasoned pro looking for fresh perspective, mentorship is extremely rewarding.  Always remember, we all have something positive to offer others. Even the smallest gesture can make a big difference!

Always happy to connect with contact center leaders, CX practitioners, and anyone working at the intersection of healthcare operations and emerging technology.
